historical_claims.anchor: Davis and Kahan developed methods for controlling how spectral subspaces move when the underlying operator is perturbed.
Davis and Kahan also studied unitarily invariant norms, whose value is unchanged by unitary changes of coordinates.
The original 1970 paper contains a broad claim about unsquared whole-space displacement that is false.
historical_claims.source_locator: Proposition 4.4; compare the corrected four-dimensional counterexample

historical_claims.anchor: Section ten of the 1970 paper raises questions that reach beyond the estimates established there.
